title: Remove dead runtime preview material helper
description: `CreatureRuntimePreview.AssignFallbackMaterial(MeshRenderer)` is a private compatibility-era helper with no current call sites. The active runtime preview path applies per-item materials through `AssignItemMaterials`, and implicit-surface material resolution uses `MaterialResolver.ResolveDefault`; TSK-0078 already consolidated palette-default material behavior and is Done. Confirm the helper remains unreferenced (including reflection/editor hooks) and then remove the dead method as a narrow cleanup. Also remove any now-unused supporting code only when the same reference inventory proves it is dead. No material behavior change is intended.
